places.quote: Amy has gone for an airing on the Iron Bridge.
places.note: Fictional-era name for Southwark Bridge; the Iron Bridge is the bridge the characters walk on.

places.normalized: Middlesex shore of the Thames, London
places.quote: as he walked on towards the Middlesex side, he saw her standing still, looking at the water.
places.note: North bank of the Thames; a side rather than a defined place.
